description: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between Max Ambiguity and Fleiss Kappa, specifically for Fleiss Kappa values associated with different levels of ambiguity. The horizontal axis represents Max Ambiguity, with categories labeled 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94 for the first chart, and 1, 2, and 3 for the second chart; the categories are arranged in ascending numerical order. The vertical axis is labeled “Fleiss Kappa” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.9 with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. The first chart contains four dark teal bars, with heights corresponding to values of approximately 0.88, 0.46, 0.03, and 0.24, respectively. The second chart contains three dark teal bars, with heights corresponding to values of approximately 0.89, 0.46, and 0.23, respectively. Each bar is labeled with its corresponding Fleiss Kappa value above the bar. No bars are visually emphasized, and there is no grouping or stacking of bars.
